notes: Catalogue data is a snapshot of publicly available Field International listings.
Fields absent from the source are stored as null and are never inferred.
Lead time is published for only 1904 of 8316 products (22.9%). Delivery-constrained queries must state this openly.
Engine is named in source text for only 543 of 8316 products. Engine must never be inferred from aircraft model.
7 listings record one part number in the SKU and a different one in the title. Both are retained and shown; the source does not resolve which is correct.
